```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

select <- dplyr::select

```

Load word count and dictionary data:

```{r load words and dicts, include=TRUE}

wordcount <- read_csv(here("data", "wordcount.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
dictionaries <- read_csv(here("data", "bila_dictionaries_withenv.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

```

```{r terms, include=TRUE}

```
